title: Sequencing of Canine Parvovirus from Rectal Swab Samples
author: Sara França de Araújo dos Santos
materials: We used Qubit dsDNA HS Assay kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32854 Qubit™ 3 Fluorometer (Fluorometer for nucleic acid quantitation, Invitrogen, Q33216, Fluorometer for nucleic acid quantitation, https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/br/en/Q33216 )

steps.title: Prepare Kit Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare all Quick-DNA/RNA Viral MagBead (Zymo Research #R2140 / R2141) solutions before starting extraction.

substeps.instruction: Proteinase K (20 mg/ml): Add 1.04 mL of Proteinase K Storage Buffer to 20 mg lyophilized Proteinase K (Kit R2140) OR add 3.12 mL of Proteinase K Storage Buffer to 60 mg lyophilized Proteinase K (Kit R2141). Vortex and use immediately or store frozen aliquots.
DNA/RNA Shield™: Add 25 mL of nuclease-free water to 2X DNA/RNA Shield™ concentrate (Kit R2140) OR add 125 mL of nuclease-free water to 2X DNA/RNA Shield™ concentrate (Kit R2141).
DNA/RNA Wash 1: Add 20 mL of isopropanol (2-propanol PA) to MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1 concentrate (Kit R2140) OR add 80 mL of isopropanol to MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1 concentrate (Kit R2141).
DNA/RNA Wash 2: Add 30 mL of isopropanol (2-propanol PA) to MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2 concentrate (Kit R2140) OR add 120 mL of isopropanol to MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2 concentrate (Kit R2141).
DNA/RNA Buffer: Add 500 µL of beta-mercaptoethanol per 100 ml Viral DNA/RNA Buffer (final concentration 0.5% v/v).

steps.title: Extract Viral DNA/RNA
steps.instruction: Extract nucleic acids from dry rectal swab samples using the modified Quick-DNA/RNA Viral MagBead protocol (can be fast-tracked using EXTRACTA 96).

substeps.instruction: Elute each dry sample into 400 µL of 1X viral DNA/RNA buffer.
Add 10 µL of beads and 4 µL of proteinase K to each sample (these can be added as a mixed solution, ensuring beads remain suspended).
Place tubes/plate on a magnetic stand, pellet the beads, and discard the supernatant.
Wash the pellet once with 250 µL of MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1 solution; pellet and discard supernatant.
Wash the pellet once with 250 µL of MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2 solution; pellet and discard supernatant.
Add 250 µL of 80% ethanol, mix well, and transfer the liquid and beads to a new tube/place.
Pellet the beads magnetically and transfer the supernatant (containing DNA/RNA) to a new plate/tube.
Add 50 µL of nuclease-free water to the beads and mix well for elution.
Pellet the beads magnetically and discard the supernatant (or collect elution as per standard elution steps).

steps.title: Prepare Primer Pools
steps.instruction: Prepare two sets of primer pools (one for ~400 bp sequences and one for ~1000 bp sequences) based on reference sequence NC_001539.1.

substeps.instruction: Create a 10X stock solution by adding 5 µL of each primer (at 100 µM) as indicated in the design tables.
Dilute the stock to a 1X working solution (10 µM).

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform PCR using Q5 High-Fidelity PCR Kit (NEB #E0555L) with independent reactions for each pool in a final volume of 25 µL.

substeps.instruction: For 400 bp products: 12.5 µL Master Mix 2X, 1.6 µL Primer pool 1 or 2, 5.9 µL Nuclease-free H2O, and 5.0 µL DNA.
For 1000 bp products: 12.5 µL Master Mix 2X, 0.4 µL Primer pool 1 or 2, 7.1 µL Nuclease-free H2O, and 5.0 µL DNA.
Set PCR thermal profile: 98 °C for 3 min; 35 cycles of (98 °C for 15 sec, 63 °C for 5 min); hold at 4 °C.
Ensure final primer concentration in the reaction is 15 nM per primer.

steps.title: Purify and Mix PCR Products
steps.instruction: Purify the amplification products and combine pools for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Mix amplification products of Pool 1 and Pool 2 to a final volume of 50 µL.
Add an equal volume (50 µL) of AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter #A63881) per sample.
After binding, place on a magnetic stand and wash beads once with 80% (v/v) ethanol.
Elute DNA with 20 µL of sequencing-appropriate buffer and transfer to a new plate/tube.

steps.title: Library Preparation and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare the sequencing library and run on an Oxford Nanopore device.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the library using Ligation Sequencing kit SQK-LSK-109 and Native Barcoding kits EXP-NBD104 and EXP-NBD114 following manufacturer instructions.
Load the library onto an R9.4 Oxford MinION flow cell (FLO-MIN106) and sequence using a MinION Mk1B device.
